purchase_price.evidence: Active MLS RS1800320: Poseidon 12th-floor corner 1BR/1BA, 69m², fully furnished, oceanfront Barbasquillo. List price $139,000. Year built 2015, remodelled 2017. 1 garage parking.

monthly_rent.source: Poseidon building rent comps; AirROI Manta STR 2026
monthly_rent.evidence: Building comps: Poseidon 2BR units advertised rented at $1,300/mo (incl. alicuota/internet/water on some ads); larger 2BR+office listed rented $1,300. Subject is 1BR 69m² — smaller. Scout $1,200 STR appears optimistic vs AirROI Manta avg $4,104/yr ($342/mo) and 21.7% occupancy. Listing claims popular rental unit. Blended estimate: LTR $750-950 or strong STR $800-1,100. Used $900 mid. Gross at $900 is 7.8% before HOA — underwriter should stress-test.

hoa_monthly.evidence: MLS Association Fee Amount (Monthly) / Valor de Alicuotas = $185 for this unit. Sibling Poseidon units show higher alicuotas ($328-$400) for larger floorplans — $185 is consistent for 1BR. HOA often includes insurance/security/pool; confirm inclusions via estoppel.

special_assessments.evidence: No special assessment disclosed on MLS listing. Poseidon is ~2015 hotel-condo; capital projects possible but no current assessment documented. Treat as UNKNOWN (not verified zero).

property_taxes_annual.evidence: Ecuador impuesto predial is 0.025%-0.5% of cadastral value (typically well below market). Comparable Manta condos often pay $100-400/yr. For ~$139,000 market price, estimated $111-417/yr; used $175. Exact bill depends on Manta municipal rate and cadastral assessment.

insurance_annual.evidence: Building structure insurance is typically included in Ecuador alicuota. Owner contents/liability: ~$140-210/yr base; Manta coastal earthquake risk adds 15-20%. For ~$139,000 condo, estimated $200-400/yr supplemental owner policy; used $325.

management_annual.evidence: STR full-service management in LatAm commonly 15-30% of gross. At estimated $900/mo ($10800/yr), 20% = $2160/yr. Co-hosting or self-management would reduce this.

utilities_annual.evidence: Some Poseidon rentals include water/internet in rent+alicuota package (owner absorbs via HOA/rent). Central AC maintenance sometimes in HOA per MLS comments on sibling units. Owner incremental utilities assumed $0 if LTR tenant-paid or STR recovered in ADR; if owner pays AC common charges beyond HOA, unknown.

other_expenses_annual.evidence: Furnished oceanfront unit: FF&E replacement reserve, possible rental program fees if using on-site hotel ops. Estimated $400/yr misc; confirm any mandatory rental program.

rental_restrictions.evidence: Poseidon operates as hotel-condo with active long-term and vacation rentals advertised building-wide. No rental ban on this listing. Confirm reglamento and any rental-program requirements.

str_restrictions.source: Poseidon building STR listings; AirROI Manta Low regulation
str_restrictions.evidence: Building commonly marketed for Airbnb/STR. City regulation Low. Hotel-condo rules may require using building management or meeting minimum standards — not verified for this unit. Confirm before underwriting STR case.

notes: Best-documented HOA in Ecuador SCREENED batch ($185 verified). After HOA, scout already flagged adjusted yield ~8.8% even at $1,200 rent; researched rent $900 is more conservative vs AirROI. Likely underwriting REJECTED/WATCHLIST unless rent proves higher. Special assessments still UNKNOWN.
